fields.Name: T305 - Communication Templates Search And Category Filter
fields.Description: Tests the bespoke template card-grid client-side applyFilter (name/description/category substring + category chips derived from data) with its own no-results empty state — not the generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Templates section. Type a term in 'Search templates...' and/or open the Filter popover and pick a Category. Success = the template card grid RESPONDS — cards narrow to matches OR a 'No templates found' empty state appears. Then search for a clearly nonsense term (e.g. 'zzzqqq') and confirm the no-results empty state appears, then clear it to restore the cards. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Searching and/or category-filtering narrows the template cards (or shows a valid empty state)
A nonsense search term produces the 'No templates found' empty state; clearing it restores cards
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
